time_unit: source model time unit; no seconds conversion

D.label: Nonzero internal inventory negative control
D.mapping: y0=sum(x0:x3), y4=x4; restart waiting reservoir; stage composition and remaining waits not preserved

sampling.event_flux_convention: right limit in trajectories; save both limits in event table; state and extent continuous
sampling.maxima_scope: fixed sampled grid; no claim of continuum supremum

windows.post_transient_rule: complement of initial/switch union, strictly after included boundary
windows.late_window_label: LATE_FIXED_DIAGNOSTIC_WINDOW; supplementary; never substitutes required screen

error_policy.normalized: absolute error / predeclared test amount or current scale
error_policy.relative: absolute error / absolute full reference only where reference != 0; undefined otherwise; no denominator clipping
error_policy.near_zero_warning: relative errors at tiny nonzero references retained with raw reference and never used as acceptance gate
error_policy.rms: time-weighted RMS with trapezoid quadrature per contiguous window component

domain.boundary_intervention_required: replace surrounding S0 reactions by prescribed u and omit active S0 undocking re0000000021 (author k=0.23); omit S4 surrounding reactions; local boundary experiment only, no source edits

gates.screen_rule: all classes must pass ENTIRE_WINDOW for each in-domain A/B/C; D remains out of domain even if metrics pass; post and late support reported separately
gates.interpretation: prospective exploratory screening budgets, not human scientific approval

threshold_rationale.amount: 1% of an initial cohort or of one mean-dwell input amount is an exploratory cumulative-output/resource budget
threshold_rationale.current: 5% of cohort/tau or unit input is an exploratory current-resolution budget
threshold_rationale.occupancy: 5% of the same amount scale bounds unfinished inventory discrepancy; hidden microstate inventory is separately descriptive
threshold_rationale.numerical: numerical residual budgets are orders below approximation budgets and do not certify kinetics
threshold_rationale.transient: 0.25tau is a declared early/switch observation band, not a fitted equilibration time; slow relaxation may remain in post window
threshold_rationale.late: fixed [5tau,10tau] tests late pulse completion and sustained input; chosen before trajectories

sensitivity.rule: multiply kinetic thresholds only; do not move windows/scales or change numerical/domain gates
